Description: NREL reV access scenario applied as availability weighting to GODEEEP capacity factors. Required when ``renewable: dataset: godeeep`` — otherwise the workflow raises. Ordered from most to least restrictive: ``limited`` is the tightest siting regime and the closest of the three to the legacy CORINE mask; ``reference`` is NREL's intermediate regime and the usual choice; ``open`` is the most permissive (sensitivity studies). Selects the avail/caps file pair downloaded from Zenodo.

If true, overlay the California Energy Commission Wind/Solar BaseScreen on the NREL exclusion raster for onwind and solar (CA-only — outside California the variant equals the base). Selects the ``_cec`` file variants. No effect on offshore tech.
If true, overlay the BOEM OSW planning-area screen on the NREL exclusion raster for offwind and offwind_floating. Selects the ``_boem`` file variants. No effect on onshore tech.

Hub-height suffix used to construct the raw GODEEEP wind capacity-factor filename (e.g. ``wind_gen_cf_2030_125m_compressed.nc``). Must match a published Zenodo record (``wind_<height>_<scenario>_compressed``). Ignored for solar.

If true, historical weather years with no NREL-screened GODEEEP record (i.e. anything but 2012) fall back to the pre-#745 bus-aggregated archives — solar 1980-2022, wind 2001-2022. Those profiles carry NO NREL land-access screening, are locked to the county-based substation tessellation they were published on, and are 100m hub height for wind regardless of ``godeeep_wind_height``. Default false: the workflow raises rather than silently substituting them. Refused outright when any renewable carrier is in ``electricity: extendable_carriers: Generator``, and when a run would mix screened (2012) and unscreened years. Intended for operational (nothing-extendable) multi-weather-year runs.
